steps.title: Access Linkedin Developer Dashboard & Account Settings
steps.purpose: Establish application identity and access developer credentials.
steps.instructions: Navigate to https://developers.linkedin.com. Sign in with your verified Linkedin administrator or developer account, and navigate to Account Settings > Developer / Integrations.
steps.howToVerify: Confirm you can access the applications management area in Linkedin.

steps.title: Register New OAuth Application in Linkedin
steps.purpose: Registers your client identity with the authorization server.
steps.instructions: Click "Register Application" or "+ Create App". Provide application name (e.g. "Linkedin Client"), Developer Website (https://linkedin.com), and choose client type (Confidential Server App with Client Secret).
steps.expectedOutcome: Application created in developer console. Client ID is generated.
steps.howToVerify: Verify application entry is created and Client ID is visible.

steps.title: Configure Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.purpose: Prevents authorization code interception by locking callbacks to your server.
steps.instructions: In the OAuth Redirect Settings, enter your callback URL (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/linkedin"). Enforce exact character matching and protocol verification.
steps.howToVerify: Check that redirect URI is saved in the whitelist without errors.

steps.title: Select Permission Scopes & Secure Client Secret
steps.purpose: Authenticates your backend server during code-for-token exchange.
steps.instructions: Configure requested API scopes for Linkedin. Generate your Client ID and Client Secret, and store them immediately in your backend environment variables (.env). Keep secrets redacted.
steps.expectedOutcome: Client Secret securely placed in server environment.
steps.howToVerify: Verify Client Secret is saved in backend environment configuration.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Redirect and Token Exchange
steps.purpose: Complete standard OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE.
steps.instructions: Redirect users to https://linkedin.com authorization URL with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, and state. When user authorizes, capture the "code" query param and POST to the token endpoint to receive an access token.
steps.expectedOutcome: Server receives JSON payload containing access_token, token_type: Bearer, and expiration.
steps.howToVerify: Verify authorization code is exchanged for an access_token payload with 200 OK.

troubleshooting.description: The redirect URI in the request does not match the registered callback URLs in developer settings.
probableCauses: Port number difference between development and registered configuration.
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify that the redirect_uri query parameter in your authorization URL exactly matches the entry in https://developers.linkedin.com.
troubleshooting.symptom: Authorization server rejects request with redirect_uri_mismatch error.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect the redirect_uri query parameter in the browser URL and compare character-for-character with registered callback URLs in https://developers.linkedin.com.
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization and verify user is directed to the consent screen rather than an error page.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Capture the full request URL excluding secrets, verify protocol and trailing slashes, and check Linkedin developer docs.

troubleshooting.description: Client authentication failed (invalid client_id or client_secret).
probableCauses: Typo in client ID or client secret.
Client secret was rotated or revoked.
troubleshooting.resolution: Regenerate the client secret in the developer console and update your server environment variables.
troubleshooting.symptom: Token exchange fails with HTTP 401 Unauthorized / invalid_client.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Check server environment variables to verify CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET match the active app credentials in the portal.
troubleshooting.verification: Trigger a code exchange request and verify server receives 200 OK with access_token payload.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Regenerate client secret in developer console, update server .env, and restart the backend server process.
